Subject: Order Form: PO timing, invoicing split & tax evidence (HelixHealth)

Hi Rosie / Martin —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is our latest Order Form (v3) with commercial redlines called out. High-level asks from Redwood:

- Confirm PO issuance timeline: we need a signed PO or DocuSign by 2027-04-01 to hold the proposed pricing and commit phasing.
- Invoicing approach: we propose split invoices by entity (US / EMEA) aligned to the commit tranches in Section A. See sample workbook attached. This avoids gross-up and keeps tax mapping clean.
- Net terms: our commercial team is flexible but requests Net45 for the initial 3-month ramp, moving to Net30 after the first invoice. If Helix cannot accept Net45, please confirm your maximum.
- Tax documentation: please provide a VAT/residency certificate for the UK entity (we've requested TaxCertificate_Helix_UK.pdf). If you expect reverse-charge treatment we need evidence before first invoice.

I've cc'd Karthik and Ben to coordinate PO timing and invoicing; Kimberly is on for legal redline confirmation.

Attachments: Helix_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (annotated), Redwood-Invoice-Sample-entity-split.xlsx

Thanks — let me know if you want a short call to walk the redlines.

Best,

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the redlines and the workbook. Quick responses from finance/procurement:

1) PO timeline — procurement can target a PO by 2027-04-15 but we cannot commit earlier than 2027-04-10 pending internal budget approvals. Will that timeline keep the proposed pricing?

2) Net terms — finance is firm on Net30 across vendors. They indicated Helix cannot accept Net45 for new platform partners.

3) Invoicing by entity — possible but finance needs a sample invoice per legal entity and confirmation of remittance details for each invoice. Your sample workbook helps; can you produce a one-page invoice example showing US vs UK entity split?

4) Tax evidence — will provide the UK VAT certificate this afternoon. Note: Helix expects Redwood to accept reverse-charge where applicable; our tax team flags that any split invoice with UK services must show supporting VAT IDs.

Also attaching our standard vendor payment form (VendorForm_Helix.pdf) — procurement requires it completed and returned before PO issuance.

If we cannot align on Net terms, we will need to discuss an offset (e.g., earlier activation payment) — cc'ing finance.

Best regards,

Thanks Rosie — appreciate the quick reply and the vendor form. A few proposed compromises from Redwood so we can move toward PO:

- Net terms: if Helix must remain Net30, Redwood can accept Net30 provided Helix issues the first PO or pays the first quarter activation invoice within 30 days of signing. In other words, Net30 but with the first invoice due on signature (or payment on the first 30-day invoice).
- Pricing hold: we can extend the pricing hold to 2027-04-15 if Helix commits to submitting the vendor form and a conditional PO by 2027-04-10. Full executed PO by 2027-04-15 is required to avoid a 7% price uplift.
- Invoicing: we'll prepare a one-page invoice mock for US and UK entities and share it later today. This will include remittance addresses and tax IDs.
- Taxes: Redwood legal asks the UK VAT certificate be sent before the first invoice. If reverse-charge applies, we'll reflect that on the UK invoice header.

Rosie / Helix team —

Appreciate the confirmation and the vendor form. Quick legal summary and next steps so procurement has a single source of truth:

- Net terms: Redwood legal confirms commercial can accept Net30 as Karthik proposed, but we need either (a) first-quarter activation invoice paid on signature or (b) a PO issued by 2027-04-15. If neither happens we reserve the right to apply the 7% uplift retroactively.

- Invoicing split: Redwood legal is comfortable with split invoicing by entity. We will provide sample invoices for the US operating entity and the UK/EU entity by EOD today. Each sample will include: invoice number pattern, remit-to, tax ID, and a short line-item mapping to the Order Form commitments.

- Tax evidence: please send the UK VAT certificate and indicate whether Helix expects reverse-charge. If reverse-charge is claimed, Helix must confirm in writing and provide the relevant VAT registration number; otherwise Redwood will invoice with VAT grossed as required.

- Vendor paperwork: Ben — finance will follow up on supplier tax forms (W-9 / W-8BEN-E). Rosie, if Helix needs Redwood to complete any internal Helix vendor fields, please mark the required fields in the VendorForm_Helix.pdf and return.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Helix returns vendor form + VAT evidence (target: 2027-03-03)
2) Redwood shares invoice samples + updated redline summary (today)
3) Procurement submits conditional PO by 2027-04-10 and executed PO by 2027-04-15 to hold pricing

Feel free to call if you prefer a 20-minute alignment — I'm available tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks,
